rows.label: Medical Expense Benefit (maximum per accident)
rows.note: Pays covered expenses for medical treatment due to accidental injury to the maximum shown: physician's fees, surgery, x-rays, reduction of fractures or other emergency first-aid expenses. All covered expenses must be incurred within 28 days of the accident. A $50 deductible applies for each accidental injury when expenses are incurred at a hospital emergency room.

rows.label: Daily Hospital Confinement Benefit
rows.note: Fixed amount per day beginning the first day of confinement, to a maximum of 30 days per hospital confinement resulting from any one accidental injury.

rows.label: Air and Ground Ambulance Benefit (maximum)
rows.note: Covered expenses for ground or air ambulance transportation within 28 calendar days of the accident, to the maximum shown.

rows.label: Accidental Death
rows.note: Death must occur within 90 days of the accident.

rows.note: Paid if the Primary Insured suffers the dismemberment as a result of accidental injury; it must occur within 90 days of the accident.

notes: Coverage 24 hours a day, anywhere in the world; pays on the job or off the job accidents.

Individual, Individual & Spouse, Single Parent, and Family coverage available.
